entropy.doc: //! 🌀️ Zero-dependency information theory for the semio table: entropies, estimators, counts and the numeric primitives every measure builds on.

dependence.doc: //! 🤝️ Dependence measures over table columns: divergences, mutual and transfer information, partial information decomposition, matrix entropies and Fisher criteria.

series.doc: //! 📈️ Series complexity measures: regularity, ordinal and Markov entropies, multiscale and Lempel-Ziv complexity, spectra, wavelets and resampling inference.

applied.doc: //! 🗂️ Applied entropy measures: streaming estimators, machine-learning uncertainty, spatial and graph entropies and the feature registry.

tabular.doc: //! 📋️ Tabular data internals of the semio table: typed columns, frames and their validation.

probability.doc: //! 🎲️ Probability internals of the semio table: distributions, densities and sampling.

statistics.doc: //! 📊️ Statistics internals of the semio table: moments, summaries and tests over tabular columns.

causal.doc: //! 🧭️ Causal inference internals of the semio table: graphs, identification and effect estimation.

descriptor.doc: //! 📇️ The semio table schema descriptor: every schema facet leaf of the table subset, for the schema registry.

model.doc: //! 🧬️ The semio table model: schema descriptor, snapshot and diff with their text, binary and SQLite codecs, and the snapshot retirement implementations.

inferences.doc: //! 💡️ The semio table inferences: shape, moments and entropy fields derived from a table snapshot, with their text and binary codecs.

mutations.doc: //! 🧬️ The semio table mutation vocabulary: every mutation with its diff and inverse, their text and binary codecs, and the member store owner.
